title: enriched category
why_consulted: vol1 ch10 §0.1.4：原文以 enriched ideology 作类比（Maps_S(s0,s1) 是 (∞,1)-范畴），「充实」这一译名须与 TERMINOLOGY.md 对齐
definition_zh: 充实范畴是把「态射集」换成某个幺半范畴 V 中对象的范畴：hom 对象 Maps(a,b) ∈ V，复合是 V 中的态射 Maps(b,c) ⊗ Maps(a,b) → Maps(a,c)，单位 id_a: 1 → Maps(a,a)，结合律与单位律在 V 中只到同构成立。DAG 第 10 章 §0.1.4 用它作类比：对 s0,s1 ∈ S^{Spc}，Maps_S(s0,s1) 本身是 (∞,1)-范畴，即 S 在 (∞,1)-范畴上「充实」，只是这里的 V 不是集合而是 (∞,1)-范畴。
key_points: 充实范畴的 hom 是 V-对象，复合用 V 的张量 ⊗ 与单位 1
取 V = Spc 得通常的 (∞,1)-范畴（空间充实）；取 V = Cat 得 2-范畴/双范畴
DAG §0.1.4 只说「精神上接近」enriched ideology，并不发展它：关键升级是 Maps_S(s0,s1) 取值于 (∞,1)-范畴而非空间，这一步正是 (∞,2)-范畴多出来的信息
校对注意：「充实（enriched）意识形态」是 enriched ideology 的直译，宜读作「充实范畴的观点」
idea_original: The notion of an enriched category is a generalization of the notion of a category. Very often, instead of merely having a set of morphisms from one object to another, a category will have a vector space of morphisms, or a topological space of morphisms, or some other such thing. This suggests that we should take the definition of a (locally small) category and generalize it by replacing the hom-sets by hom-objects, which are objects in a suitable category KK. This gives the concept of an ‘enriched category’. The category KK must be monoidal, so that we can define composition as a morphism ∘:hom(y,z)⊗hom(x,y)→hom(x,z) \circ : hom(y,z) \otimes hom(x,y) \to hom(x,z) So, a category enriched over KK (also called a category enriched in KK, or simply a KK-category), say CC, has a collection ob(C)ob(C) of objects and, for each pair x,y∈ob(C)x,y \in ob(C), a ‘hom-object’ hom(x,y)∈K. hom(x,y) \in K . We then mimic the usual definition of a category. We may similarly define a functor enriched over KK and a natural transformation enriched over KK, obtaining a strict 2-category of KK-enriched categories, K K -Cat.
